question.text: A PMS model portfolio gets flagged for 35% exposure to a single sector against an IPS limit of 25%. The PM must:

answer.text: Breach is a breach — rebalance to within limits per IPS

explanation.text: The Logic: IPS limits are binding; rebalance to within limits and document breach cure. The Trap: Verbal limit changes bypass compliance. Cross-Exam Context: Same rule in III-A. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Use a daily breach monitor; cure within 3 business days to avoid escalation.
